title: Low-Cal Paneer Mawa Modak

ingredients.as_written: 1 cup homemade crumbled paneer (I am using low fat) - around 150g
Kesar – 8–10 strands soaked in 30-40 ml warm skimmed milk
Kesar – 8–10 strands soaked in 30-40 ml warm skimmed milk
Pinch of turmeric powder for color
3-4 tbsp sweetner of choice (I am using zero calorie sweetner - Monkfruit extract)

steps: Blend the paneer until its smooth to mimic mawa like texture.
Add ghee to a pan, along with milk powder and the blended paneer.
Add the saffron infused milk gradually, stirring until it comes together like soft mava.
Add cardamom powder, and sweetener of your choice.
Stir well until mixture thickens into a soft dough-like consistency. (Don’t overcook or it’ll get dry.)
Let the mixture cool down and then need it well to make sure it’s very smooth without any lumps.
Grease a modak mould with a drop of ghee, stuff the mixture in, press, and unmould.
Tip - The dough should not stick to your fingers. If it sticks, then its too wet so add 1 tbsp of milk powder and cook for 2 to 3 minutes.
assumptions: The creator gives 70–80 kcal per modak; we use the upper figure.
